== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Release Your Anger (V) (Errata)]] (<code>2220_1064</code>, Virtual Block 2 slip 64), showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published image shows this text: the Virtual Block 2 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB2-64-Release_Your_Anger.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB2-D-releaseyouranger-pre.gif]]) both show the original text of [[Release Your Anger (V)]].

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee website card list (VBlock2Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064711/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock2Type.html 2012-07-21] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142857/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock2Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive). The card list drops icons; the icons are those of the printed slip, drawn as icons. Published typos are kept as printed. The card list writes the ▲ icon out as “Take … into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle”; the image shows the ▲ icon. The first sentence is set in italics as on the printed card.
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “Destiny +2 when drawn for weapon or lightsaber combat destiny. USED: Take Your Powers Are Weak, Old Man into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. LOST: If you just lost a character armed with a non-[Permanent Weapon] lightsaber, lose 1 Force to take that character (or lightsaber) into hand.”
* '''Made:''' 8 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 71) from the card's own Virtual Legacy card (<code>1220_064</code>: Decipher art, frame, title, lore, icons, Virtual Block 2 set mark, slip number 64 as on the Players Committee card image, copyright line) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039. Rebuild spec: <code>VB2-64-Release_Your_Anger-PC-E1-cardmaker.png.spec.json</code> in the batch B05 run folder.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
